cause: malformed or invalid request content/format
avoidance: validate request shape client-side before sending

cause: malformed/revoked/expired API key or bad AWS SigV4
avoidance: rotate/check key; check Key expiration docs

cause: billing/payment issue on the account
avoidance: check payment details in Claude Console

cause: API key lacks permission for the resource
avoidance: check org/workspace access settings

cause: wrong endpoint path or resource id
avoidance: verify URL and resource id

cause: concurrent modification or uniqueness violation
avoidance: retry after resolving the conflicting state

cause: request exceeds per-endpoint byte max (32MB Messages/Token Counting; 256MB Batch; 500MB Files)
avoidance: split or reduce payload before sending

cause: org rate limit / monthly spend cap / Claude Code workspace spend limit
avoidance: backoff honoring retry-after; treat spend-cap 429 (no retry-after) as non-retryable

cause: internal Anthropic error
avoidance: retry with exponential backoff; contact support with request_id if persistent

cause: request timed out while processing
avoidance: use streaming Messages API for long-running requests

cause: API temporarily overloaded across all users
avoidance: retry with backoff; ramp own traffic gradually to avoid acceleration-limit 429s

cause: context compaction drops one half of a tool_use/tool_result pair in long sessions
avoidance: avoid manually editing assistant/tool message history; keep sessions shorter or let compaction run untouched

cause: MCP tool name (mcp__server__tool) too long
avoidance: keep server and tool names short; shorten the mcp__<server>__<tool> spelling

tool: MCP client (general, per Anthropic context-engineering guidance)
error_text_or_code: context budget exhausted / degraded tool selection with many tools
cause: all tool definitions loaded into context up front
avoidance: use deferred tool loading / tool search (defer_loading) once toolset is large

error_text_or_code: corrupted/unparseable stdout stream (client-side JSON-RPC parse failure)
cause: server writes debug/log text, a stray print(), or a library's banner to stdout instead of stderr, breaking the newline-delimited JSON-RPC framing
avoidance: route all logging to stderr (spec explicitly allows UTF-8 stderr for any logging); never let a dependency's default logger or a print statement write to stdout; the client MUST NOT assume stderr output is an error condition either

cause: server writes a JSON-RPC request to stdout (servers MUST NOT initiate requests on stdio) or omits the newline delimiter
avoidance: only write responses/notifications correlated by id; always terminate each message with exactly one newline and no embedded newlines

error_text_or_code: MCP server treated as dead / restarted
cause: stdio server process exits unexpectedly (crash, unhandled exception, OOM)
avoidance: client restarts it per spec guidance; because MCP is stateless per request this drops in-flight requests — make tool handlers idempotent so a mid-call restart is safe to retry

error_text_or_code: tool call aborts with idle-timeout error
cause: no response or progress notification within CLAUDE_CODE_MCP_TOOL_IDLE_TIMEOUT (5 min HTTP/SSE/WS/connector; 30 min stdio by default)
avoidance: send periodic notifications/progress on long-running tools, or raise the idle timeout / per-server timeout explicitly for known-slow tools

cause: server fails to complete initialization within MCP_TIMEOUT
avoidance: reduce server startup work (lazy-load heavy imports), or raise MCP_TIMEOUT for known-slow servers

error_text_or_code: first headless turn stalls waiting for MCP servers
cause: non-interactive (``-p``) run's first turn blocks on slow-connecting MCP servers
avoidance: bound the wait with CLAUDE_CODE_MCP_STARTUP_WAIT_MS (added 2.1.274) so a scheduled/CI run fails fast instead of hanging

error_text_or_code: permission prompt blocks a non-interactive run
cause: a tool call (e.g. an rm command) needs approval but there is no TTY to answer it
avoidance: scope --allowedTools narrowly for headless runs; the dangerous-rm prompt (2.1.277) now names the flagged command and suggests a ${VAR:?} guard so the run can be fixed and re-run instead of hanging silently

cause: a single very large first prompt, or a hook-driven session (e.g. active /goal) that overflows context again after a prior compaction
avoidance: let Claude Code summarize the oversized first prompt on its own (2.1.281) rather than manually truncating; hook-driven sessions should trigger compaction, not error, on repeat overflow (fixed 2.1.274)

cause: the model refuses the summarization request that drives /compact
avoidance: Claude Code retries compaction on a fallback model (fixed 2.1.282); a session stuck here should be restarted rather than assumed hung

error_text_or_code: restored memory / cache-miss after compaction or resume
cause: a restored memory file's relative "age" note (e.g. "3 days ago") changes on every request, invalidating the prompt cache
avoidance: fixed 2.1.275 by freezing the age note; sessions on older Claude Code versions should avoid memory content that re-renders per-request timestamps

cause: the server-side sampling loop reached its iteration limit (default 10 per request) while running server tools such as web search
avoidance: send the response back as-is to let Claude continue; a client tool_use wait is stop_reason tool_use instead

cause: Claude declined to respond; safety classifiers return it as a normal HTTP 200 with stop_details naming the policy category
avoidance: do not resend the same request to the same model; retry on a fallback model as documented

cause: the response filled the model's context window
avoidance: treat the response as truncated; reduce input (trim history or summarize); distinct from the request-time 413 request_too_large which fires before generation starts

cause: a proxy sends a trailing usage-only frame that drops the real stop_reason
avoidance: fixed in Claude Code 2.1.281; pin to 2.1.281+ when running behind a streaming proxy

error_text_or_code: tool schema rejected (400) under strict mode
cause: schema sets an object without additionalProperties:false, or omits a property from required
avoidance: set additionalProperties:false on every object and list every property (including optional ones, typed as [T, null]) in required

cause: combined prompt instructions (agent + node + system) exceed an internal, undocumented threshold, even though the visible 8,000-character field cap is not exceeded
avoidance: shorten combined instructions across all contributing fields, not just the one field showing a character counter

cause: a call to an AI Builder model timed out
avoidance: retry, reduce input size, or check the AI Builder model's own limits

cause: accumulated conversation/topic variable state exceeds the maximum allowed size
avoidance: trim variables, avoid storing large blobs in conversation state, reset state between unrelated flows

cause: Dataverse or SharePoint throttled the underlying search/attachment request
avoidance: wait and retry with backoff; reduce request rate; see Microsoft Graph throttling guidance

cause: a tool, flow action, or upstream service exceeded its configured execution/response time limit
avoidance: increase the configured timeout where supported, add retry with backoff, review target-service performance

cause: the agent's generative-AI search-and-summarize usage limit (message capacity) was reached
avoidance: review message capacity / generative AI limits under quotas and licensing; see 'Resolve throttling errors in agents'

cause: the agent's generative-orchestration usage limit was reached
avoidance: same remediation as above, scoped to orchestration/tool-planning calls

cause: a tool call's request rate exceeded the target service's limits
avoidance: add backoff, limit batch concurrency, monitor usage/throttling in analytics

cause: the agent reached its maximum number of generative-answer responses (capacity)
avoidance: review message capacity and billing plan; see 'Resolve throttling errors in agents'

cause: the agent reached its message capacity or pay-as-you-go meter limit
avoidance: add prepaid capacity or a pay-as-you-go billing plan; chat resumes within about 5 minutes once resolved

cause: a tool call failed because a monthly, daily, or concurrency quota limit was exceeded
avoidance: review and raise the relevant quota, or reduce call volume/concurrency

cause: a real-time connector returned a payload larger than the agent can handle
avoidance: reduce payload size via connector filters, or limit configured action outputs

cause: outgoing message exceeds a channel's byte limit (e.g. 262,144 bytes on some channels)
avoidance: channel-imposed limit, not a Copilot Studio limit; reduce message/file size for that channel

cause: a connected (child) agent is missing a description or instructions the orchestrator needs to decide when to call it
avoidance: give the connected agent a clear description and instructions

cause: a prompt-injection attack was detected embedded in grounded data supplied by a document or user (not the agent author)
avoidance: align instructions with intended behavior; reinforce responsible-AI guidance for users; a general instance of the 'never trust ingested data' rule

cause: the bot/agent contains too much content overall (many topics, long messages) to operate
avoidance: reduce message lengths or number of topics

cause: number of dialogs executed in one turn exceeded the default maximum of 50
avoidance: reduce the number of topics chained in a single turn

cause: the bot sent more than the per-turn message limit (default under 30) in one turn
avoidance: limit messages emitted per turn

error_text_or_code: HTTP 429 on connector actions inside an agent flow
cause: the flow's connector action exceeded the connector's or Dataverse's per-minute/per-day API limits
avoidance: add retry-with-backoff and concurrency limits in the flow; monitor throttling in Power Platform admin analytics (same throttling family as HTTP429TooManyRequests / DataverseStructured429 above)
